segments.text: Your electric toothbrush charges through solid plastic.
a battery, a circuit board, and two copper coils.
The charger base hides a coil too.
Its current flips back and forth,
It makes current flow in the handle's coil.
No holes, so no water gets in.
The second coil pushes a magnet back and forth,

segments.say: up to thirty-one thousand strokes a minute.

segments.text: A tiny chip times your two minutes.

segments.say: An early electric toothbrush, from nineteen fifty-four,

segments.text: what's inside a digital kitchen scale?
